ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: The graph of the linear function $y=kx+b$ (where $k$ and $b$ are constants and $k\neq 0$) is shown in the figure, and it passes through the point $(-2, 0)$. What is the solution set of the inequality $kx+b>0$ with respect to $x$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since the linear function $y=kx+b$ passes through the point $(-2, 0)$, \\
it follows that the solution set for $kx+b>0$ is $\boxed{x<-2}$.
